name: Stargate
description: Stargate is a cross-chain liquidity transfer protocol built on LayerZero. It moves native assets such as USDC, USDT and ETH between EVM chains using unified liquidity pools.
description_zh: Stargate 是基于 LayerZero 构建的跨链流动性转移协议，利用统一流动性池在 EVM 链之间转移 USDC、USDT 和 ETH 等原生资产。

geo_feature.scope: USDC transfers over Circle CCTP: the app first asks Circle's CCTP API (iris-api.circle.com/v1/publicKeys) and, when it does not answer, refuses the route with 'CCTP transfers are not available in your region'. Circle answers 403 'Lockout' to Ukrainian IPs (3 networks tested on 2026-10-12); other routes stay available.

notes: Closed frontend. The CCTP route depends on Circle's API being reachable from the visitor's location.
live: iris-api.circle.com/v1/publicKeys (2026-10-12): UA -> HTTP 403 'Lockout' (3 networks); RO US GB TR AE SG HK BR JP -> 200
evidence: stargate.finance bundle: validateRegion throws UsdcCctpRegionRestrictedError when /v1/publicKeys fails
